base_dir.description: Base directory where buildd stores build artifacts, logs, and queues.

port.description: TCP port the buildd daemon listens on for incoming connections (e.g., from sbuild or dput).

bind_addr.description: Network interface address to bind to. Use `0.0.0.0` to allow remote connections (not recommended without firewall).

max_jobs.description: Maximum number of simultaneous builds. Set to `0` to disable concurrency limits.

max_log_size.description: Maximum size (in megabytes) per build log file. Larger logs are truncated at the end.

log_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain build logs before automatic cleanup.

debug.description: Debug logging level. (Note: Schema type changed to number for numeric config value)

architectures.description: List of CPU architectures this buildd is configured to build for.

suites.description: Distributions (suites) from which this buildd will accept source packages to build.

upload_host.description: Hostname or address of the upload target (e.g., upload server, FTP master, or local queue directory).

upload_keyfile.description: Path to SSH private key used for secure upload of built packages.

apt_sources.description: Optional list of additional APT repository sources to use during build (e.g., for custom or backport repos). Each entry adds an `APT_SOURCE_*` line.

keyring_dir.description: Directory containing trusted APT repository keyrings for signature verification.

auto_accept.description: If true, buildd automatically accepts queued source uploads without manual intervention.

admin_mail.description: Email address for buildd admin notifications.

build_log_keep.description: Number of days until build logs are archived.

daemon_log_keep.description: Number of days until old daemon logs are archived in a .tar.gz file.

pkg_log_keep.description: Number of days until package logs are archived.
